name: 5Devs
summary: Generates fake Brazilian company and address data, such as CNPJ and CEP, for testing.
description: Browser tool that generates mock Brazilian business data: razão social, CNPJ, inscrição estadual, data de abertura, telefone, site and email, plus address fields (CEP, número, complemento, bairro, cidade, estado). Results can be copied as JSON, with options to change mask, date format and tab.
contains: fake Brazilian company data: razão social, CNPJ, inscrição estadual, opening date, phone, site, email
address fields: CEP, número, complemento, bairro, cidade, estado
Enter generates, Shift copies the JSON
options to change mask, date format and tab
